source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.3 with Figs. 2.2 to 2.4 (PDF 25-28, printed 22-25).

blocks.text: Vectors ko do tarah zarb (multiply) kiya jata hai. In do qismon ke hasil-e-zarb (product) ko scalar product aur vector product kehte hain.
Agar do vectors ke zarb se scalar quantity mile to use scalar product kehte hain, aur agar do vectors ke zarb se vector quantity mile to use vector product kehte hain.
Scalar ya Dot Product
Do vectors A⃗ aur B⃗ ka scalar product A⃗.B⃗ likha jata hai (beech mein dot), aur is ki tareef (definition) yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos θ   (2.6)

blocks.text: Yahan A aur B vectors A⃗ aur B⃗ ki miqdarein hain aur θ un ke darmiyan angle hai.
Dot product ka matlab samajhne ke liye dono vectors ki dumein (tails) ek hi nuqte (common origin) par rakhte hain (Fig. 2.2 a). Phir:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.B⃗ = A (projection of B⃗ on A⃗)

blocks.latex: \text{or}\quad \vec{A}\cdot\vec{B} = A\,(\text{magnitude of component of } \vec{B} \text{ in the direction of } \vec{A}),\ \text{Fig. 2.2(b)}
blocks.text_alt: or A⃗.B⃗ = A (magnitude of component of B⃗ in the direction of A⃗), Fig. 2.2(b)

blocks.text: Yani B cos θ, vector B⃗ ka woh hissa hai jo A⃗ ki simt mein hai (Fig. 2.2 b):

blocks.text_alt: = A (B cos θ) = AB cos θ
Similarly, B⃗.A⃗ = B (A cos θ) = BA cos θ

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Vector A neeche seedha hai; vector B zaviye theta par uthta hai; B ke sire se A tak dashed line girti hai, aur A ka woh hissa B cos theta likha hai. (b) Wahi zaviya; A ke sire se dashed line B se seedhe zaviye par milti hai, aur B ka woh hissa A cos theta likha hai.
blocks.caption: Dot product: B ka A par saya (projection) (a) aur A ka B par (b) (Figure 2.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yeh product hamein kaam (work) mein milta hai. Farz karein force F⃗ kisi cheez ko d faasle tak le jati hai, aur harkat ki simt F⃗ ki line of action ke saath angle θ banati hai (Fig. 2.3).

blocks.latex: \text{Work done} = (\text{Effective component of force in the direction of motion}) \times \text{Distance moved}
blocks.text_alt: Work done = (Effective component of force in the direction of motion) × Distance moved
= (F cos θ) d = Fd cos θ

blocks.text: Vector notation mein:

blocks.text_alt: F⃗.d⃗ = Fd cos θ = Work done

blocks.alt: Lakri ka block; us ke kone se force F ufuq (horizontal) se zawiya theta par kheenchti hai. Displacement d ufqi simt mein hai; F ki nok se us par nuqta-daar lakeer girti hai, aur F cos theta F ka woh hissa hai jo d ke saath hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.3: Displacement d se zawiya θ par force F ka kaam (kitab ki Figure 2.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Scalar product ki khusoosiyat (characteristics)
1. A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos θ aur B⃗.A⃗ = BA cos θ = AB cos θ, is liye A⃗.B⃗ = B⃗.A⃗. Zarb ki tarteeb (order) se farq nahi parta; yani scalar product commutative hai.
2. Do perpendicular vectors (θ = 90°) ka scalar product zero hota hai, kyun ke cos 90° = 0.

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos 90° = 0

blocks.text: 3. Do parallel vectors ka scalar product un ki miqdaron ke zarb ke barabar hota hai. Parallel vectors (θ = 0°) ke liye cos 0° = 1:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos 0° = AB

blocks.text: Antiparallel (ulti simt wale) vectors (θ = 180°) ke liye cos 180° = -1:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos 180° = -AB

blocks.text: Kisi vector A⃗ ka apne aap se scalar product us ki miqdar ke square ke barabar hota hai:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.A⃗ = AA cos 0° = A²

blocks.text: Rectangular components ki shakal mein do vectors A⃗ aur B⃗ ka scalar product:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.B⃗ = AxBx + AyBy + AzBz   (2.7)

blocks.text: Equation (2.6) se do vectors ke darmiyan angle nikal sakte hain. Kyun ke

blocks.text_alt: A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos θ = AxBx + AyBy + AzBz
Therefore cos θ = (AxBx + AyBy + AzBz)/AB   (2.8)

blocks.text: Vector ya Cross Product
Do vectors A⃗ aur B⃗ ka vector product ek vector hai, jis ki tareef yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin θ n̂   (2.9)

blocks.alt: Vectors A aur B ek rangeen satah (plane) mein hain, darmiyan zawiya theta. A x B dono ki mushtarka dum se seedha oopar, satah par amood hai; saath chhota teer unit vector n-hat hai, aur A x B ke gird ghoomta teer A se B ki taraf ghumao dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(a): Vector product A × B, A aur B ki satah par amood n̂ ke saath (kitab ki Figure 2.4(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yahan n̂ ek unit vector (miqdar 1 wala vector) hai jo A⃗ aur B⃗ wali satah (plane) par perpendicular hai (Fig. 2.4 a). Is ki simt right hand rule se maloom hoti hai: A⃗ aur B⃗ ki dumein ek jagah rakhein; yeh dono ek plane banate hain. Product vector is plane par perpendicular hota hai. Pehle vector A⃗ ko chhote angle ke raste B⃗ ki taraf ghumayein, aur daen haath ki ungliyan isi ghumao ki taraf mor lein, angootha seedha khara rakhein. Seedha angootha product vector ki simt batata hai (Fig. 2.4 b). Isi qaide ki wajah se B⃗ × A⃗, A⃗ × B⃗ ka ulta (opposite sign wala) vector hai (Fig. 2.4 c). Is liye:

blocks.alt: Wahi satah A, B aur theta ke saath. Oopar daayan haath, ungliyan A se B ki taraf mudi hui aur angootha seedha; angootha n-hat ki simt, yani A x B ki simt mein hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(b): A × B ki simt ke liye right-hand rule (kitab ki Figure 2.4(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Satah mein A, B aur theta, ab ghumao B se A ki taraf. B x A mushtarka dum se seedha neeche hai, A x B ke ulat, gird ghoomte teer ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(c): B × A, A × B ke ulat hai (kitab ki Figure 2.4(c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Ek nuqte se zawiya theta par bane vectors A aur B ek rangeen parallelogram ke do saath wale kinare hain; baqi do kinare nuqta-daar hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.4(d): A aur B ko saath wale kinare bana kar bana parallelogram (kitab ki Figure 2.4(d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Cross product ki khusoosiyat
1. A⃗ × B⃗ aur B⃗ × A⃗ barabar nahi, is liye cross product non-commutative hai:
2. Do perpendicular vectors (θ = 90°) ka cross product sab se zyada (maximum) hota hai, kyun ke sin 90° = 1:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin 90° n̂ = AB n̂

blocks.text: 3. Do parallel vectors ka cross product null vector (zero vector) hota hai, kyun ke un ke liye θ = 0° ya 180°, aur sin 0° = sin 180° = 0:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin 0° n̂ = 0 or A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin 180° n̂ = 0

blocks.text: Isi wajah se A⃗ × A⃗ = 0 (θ = 0°).
4. A⃗ × B⃗ ki miqdar us parallelogram ke area (raqba) ke barabar hai jis ke do saath wale kinare (adjacent sides) A⃗ aur B⃗ hon (Fig. 2.4 d).
Vector product ki misalein

i. Jab kisi rigid body (sakht jism) par force F⃗ aise nuqte par lagti hai jis ka position vector, ghoomne wali axis ke kisi nuqte se, r⃗ hai, to force ka ghumane wala asar, yani torque τ, r⃗ aur F⃗ ka vector product hai:
ii. Magnetic field B⃗ mein charge q aur velocity v⃗ wale zarre (particle) par force F⃗, v⃗ aur B⃗ ke vector product se milti hai:

blocks.caption: Dono products ka muqabla
rows: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin θ n̂
A⃗ aur B⃗ ke plane par perpendicular vector (right hand rule)
torque τ⃗ = r⃗ × F⃗; F⃗ = q(v⃗ × B⃗)

blocks.prompt: Do vectors ke cross product aur scalar product ki miqdarein 4√3 aur 4 hain. Un ke darmiyan angle nikalein. Yeh bhi batayein ke dot product kab sab se zyada hota hai aur cross product kab.
blocks.explanation: AB sin θ = 4√3 aur AB cos θ = 4. Dono ko taqseem karein: tan θ = √3, is liye θ = 60°. Dot product parallel vectors ke liye sab se zyada hai (cos θ = 1) aur cross product perpendicular vectors ke liye (sin θ = 1).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Dot product: A⃗.B⃗ = AB cos θ = A × (A⃗ par B⃗ ka projection) = AxBx + AyBy + AzBz; commutative; perpendicular ke liye 0, parallel ke liye AB, khud se A²; work = F⃗.d⃗.

Cross product: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin θ n̂, right hand rule se plane par perpendicular; A⃗ × B⃗ = -B⃗ × A⃗; perpendicular ke liye maximum, parallel ke liye null; miqdar = parallelogram ka area; torque r⃗ × F⃗, force q(v⃗ × B⃗).
